description: This Java class provides utility methods for constructing file paths for images related to products, manufacturers, store logos, and other content types within a web application. It centralizes and standardizes the URL/path generation logic for static images used in the application.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: A utility class for generating standardized file paths for images in the web application.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static content images based on store and image name.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for manufacturer images based on store, manufacturer, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for product images based on store, product, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Overloaded method that constructs a product image path based on store, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for large product images based on store, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for store logo images.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for product property images.
